title: Geometry 28
note: The ui-geometry showcase: the 24 ARIA patterns of aria-24, group for group, plus a Type group and a Space group, 28 specimens in ten groups. Depictions are the required depictions of ui-geometry/references/showcase.md, which is their source. The first eight groups equal aria-24 (checked by bento.test.mjs).

specimens.label: Button
specimens.depiction: Default, focused and disabled states of the same labelled action

specimens.label: Link
specimens.depiction: Inline link and external destination indicator

specimens.label: Toolbar
specimens.depiction: Related actions with one selected toggle

specimens.label: Checkbox
specimens.depiction: Unchecked, checked and indeterminate

specimens.label: Radio group
specimens.depiction: Three or more options, exactly one selected

specimens.label: Switch
specimens.depiction: On and off

specimens.label: Textbox
specimens.depiction: Labelled default, focused and invalid states; invalid has an error message

specimens.label: Combobox
specimens.depiction: Editable value, expanded suggestion list, highlighted suggestion

specimens.label: Spinbutton
specimens.depiction: Value, decrement and increment actions

specimens.label: Listbox
specimens.depiction: Three or more options, one selected

specimens.label: Menu
specimens.depiction: Open action menu with a disabled item and a separated action group

specimens.label: Tree view
specimens.depiction: Expanded parent, child items, collapsed branch, selected item

specimens.label: Tabs
specimens.depiction: Two or more tabs, one selected, and its content region

specimens.label: Menu bar
specimens.depiction: Several top-level items, one menu open

specimens.label: Breadcrumb
specimens.depiction: Three or more levels, current location identified, one line

specimens.label: Accordion
specimens.depiction: One expanded section with content and one collapsed

specimens.label: Dialog
specimens.depiction: Title, supporting content, completion or dismissal action

specimens.label: Alert dialog
specimens.depiction: Consequence statement and two clearly distinguished decisions

specimens.label: Alert
specimens.depiction: Status indicator and concise message

specimens.label: Tooltip
specimens.depiction: Visible tooltip tied to its trigger

specimens.label: Progress bar
specimens.depiction: Determinate progress with a matching numeric value

specimens.label: Slider
specimens.depiction: Track, thumb, current value and range endpoints

specimens.label: Meter
specimens.depiction: Bounded measurement with value, unit and range

specimens.label: Data grid
specimens.depiction: Column headers, two or more rows, one focused or selected cell

specimens.label: Display and heading roles
specimens.depiction: display-lg to heading-sm, each at true size in its line box, with size, line height and the line height in q

specimens.label: Title, body, label and kicker roles
specimens.depiction: title-lg to kicker-sm, each at true size in its line box, with size, line height and the line height in q

specimens.label: Gap ladder
specimens.depiction: Six rungs, each a pair of siblings with its gap marked and named: groups d, blocks d/2, fields 2I, caption I, field label g_c, joined 0

specimens.label: Container padding ladder
specimens.depiction: Card d, popover ¾d, dialog 1½d and panel 2I, each a frame with its padding marked and named
